name: Apothecary's Hand
text: Everything you need fits in one satchel and none of it looks like a weapon. When you complete a Long Rest you prepare a number of toxin doses equal to the maximum face value of your Focus Die. Coating a weapon or a piece of ammunition costs no AP and spends the dose. The next creature you damage with that weapon carries your toxin and is Bleeding until it is treated.

name: The Slow Kill
text: Nothing you do to a target is meant to be felt all at once. The first time each round that you damage a creature carrying your toxin, or that an enemy springs one of your snares, you gain 1 Momentum. Toxin ticking away on its own does not feed you; the strike or the sprung trap does.

name: Toxic Rupture
text: Your compounds stay stable right up until the wound opens wide enough to let them move. When an Impact Die Explodes against a creature carrying your toxin, spend 1 Momentum to add one Focus Die to that attack's Impact Roll.

name: Field Craft
text: You were working this ground before anyone else agreed the fight had started. For 1 AP and 1 Focus Point, set a snare in an unoccupied space within 15ft that you can see. The first enemy to enter that space must succeed on an Agility Save or be Restrained until the end of its next turn; on a success it is Slowed by 10ft until the end of its next turn instead. You may keep two snares set at once, and a third replaces the oldest.

name: Smoke and Powder
text: A handful of caustic powder buys a friend more time than any blade of yours could. For 1 AP and 1 Focus Point, throw a pellet to a point within 30ft. Each enemy within 10ft of it must succeed on an Agility Save or be Blinded until the end of its next turn. The smoke hangs until the start of your next turn, and any ally standing in it is Concealed.

name: Nerve Agent
text: You cut every dose with something that finds the hands long before it finds the heart. A creature carrying your toxin Downgrades its Impact Die on every attack it makes against you.

name: Noxious Cloud
text: Requires any two Venom Majors. The charge bursts into a low fog that clings to everything it settles on. For 1 AP, 2 Momentum and 1 Focus Point, choose a point within 30ft and roll your Focus Die against the Agility Defense of every enemy within 20ft of it; each enemy hit takes that damage and carries your toxin, spending no dose. On a Glancing Blow the enemy carries your toxin but takes no damage. If any die Explodes, the fog holds until the end of your next turn and takes hold in any enemy that enters it.

name: Kill Zone
text: You have been building this ground since before anyone else arrived on it. Once per combat, for 1 AP and 2 Focus Points, seed a 20ft radius area centered on a point within 30ft. The area is Difficult Terrain, and any enemy that enters it or starts its turn in it must succeed on an Agility Save or be Restrained until the end of its next turn. An enemy that fails that Save also carries your toxin, spending no dose, and has its Agility Defense Sundered by 1 for the remainder of combat. The zone remains until combat ends.
